python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.FlipView(%PARENT%)
for badge_text, title, summary_text in [
    ("Slide 1 of 3", "Sunrise", "Warm amber highlights and hero-banner contrast check."),
    ("Slide 2 of 3", "Ocean", "Balanced blue palette for calm workspace surfaces."),
    ("Slide 3 of 3", "Forest", "Natural green accents with high-legibility captions."),
]:
    page = fluentqt.Card()
    lay = QVBoxLayout(page)
    lay.setContentsMargins(20, 16, 20, 16)
    lay.setSpacing(6)
    badge = fluentqt.Label(badge_text, page)
    badge.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Caption)
    badge.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
    lay.addWidget(badge)
    heading = fluentqt.Label(title, page)
    heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
    lay.addWidget(heading)
    summary = fluentqt.Label(summary_text, page)
    summary.setWordWrap(True)
    summary.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
    lay.addWidget(summary)
    lay.addStretch()
    control.addOwnedPage(page)
control.setCurrentIndex(0)
